warnings: Stair 1 (two identical stairs, bays 4-5 and 17-18). Two flights recorded as two entries of the same mark with their own level, plus the landing / floor slabs S5 detailed on this sheet (S-12 refers S3-S4-S5 to the stair details).

The bottom dimension row gives the G3 landing-beam line: 'ประมาณ 1.93m' from G4 (row C), 3.57 to row B, 2.50 to row A, 5.50 C-B overall; the top row gives B3 at 2.55 from row C and 2.95 from row B — both are in the grid master.
The floor-2 beam at row C is labelled 'B2' in this section but B6 on plan S-04 (stair bay) — the plan is taken for the position mark, the conflict noted here.
Riser 0.175 / tread 0.275 + nosing 0.025 (ขยายลูกขั้นบันได); waist 0.15 for both flights.
หมายเหตุมุมซ้ายล่างทุกแผ่นรายละเอียดคาน: 'เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อย ทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40'
